description: O.S. MAX 61 SF Special Edition modelled in Blender by the owner's engine track (glow_engine_61_trabajo_completo/LEEME.txt). Owner instruction 2026-10-25: use it on the Ugly Stik.
provenance: Owner-supplied original work; no third-party mesh. Delivery kept untracked at the repository root; only the generated runtime GLB is bundled.

engine_realtime.use: engine body, head, carburettor, silencer and propeller drive with baked textures (134k triangles)

mount.use: O.S. 905 radial mount, its bolts and washers, silicone fuel and pressure lines and firewall grommets; the stand-in firewall and nose box are dropped
